headline: Business Intelligence Analyst | Data Visualization and Analytics
summary: Highly motivated Business Intelligence Analyst with a passion for leveraging data to drive strategic decision-making. Proven ability to analyze complex datasets, develop insightful reports, and communicate findings to stakeholders effectively. Strong proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Python. Eager to contribute to a data-driven organization and further develop analytical skills.

bullets: Developed interactive dashboards in Power BI that increased user engagement by 25% and facilitated data-driven insights for marketing campaigns.
Utilized SQL to query and analyze customer data, identifying key trends and patterns that led to a 10% improvement in customer retention rate.
Designed and implemented automated data pipelines using dbt, streamlining data processing and reducing report generation time by 30%.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements and translate them into actionable data visualizations.
